0022600213.text: The LA Clippers (2-7, 13th in the West, 0-4 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (3-6, 12th in the West, 3-3 at home) in the Clippers' 10th game of the season, with both teams having played nine games so far. This is the first meeting of 2026-27, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the last meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Cam Christie (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while the Suns are without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery).
